title: Towards using Large Language Models for Risk Negotiation and Consensus-building in One Health contexts
abstract: arXiv:2509.09906v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Risk negotiation under the One Health framework requires balancing competing stakeholder interests across human, animal, and environmental health domains - a process constrained by information complexity and time pressure. This study presents and evaluates a multi-step pipeline that integrates large language model-based agents into a human-supervised negotiation process, specifically targeting risk assessment, valuation, and negotiation steps. Agent descriptions were generated from stakeholder-provided materials using retrieval-augmented generation methods. During preliminary multi-agent discussions, agents accessed domain-specific computational models and web-based sources before human participants refined proposed issues and options. translated_title: 迈向利用大语言模型在全健康背景下进行风险谈判与共识构建
translated_abstract: 全健康框架下的风险谈判需要在人类、动物和环境健康各领域的利益相关者相互竞争的利益之间取得平衡——这一过程受到信息复杂性和时间压力的制约。本研究提出并评估了一个多步骤流程，将基于大语言模型的智能体整合到人工监督的谈判过程中，专门针对风险评估、价值评估和谈判等步骤。智能体描述是通过检索增强生成方法从利益相关者提供的材料中生成的。在初步的多智能体讨论中，智能体会访问特定领域的计算模型和网络资源，随后由人类参与者完善拟议的议题和选项。接着，模拟谈判游戏产生了候选协议的分布，并使用纳什议价解标准和帕累托最优指标对其进行表征。所开发的方法被评估……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究提出并评估了一种将基于大语言模型的智能体整合进人工监督谈判流程的多步骤方法，用于全健康背景下的风险评估、价值评估与谈判，并通过纳什议价解标准和帕累托最优指标对模拟谈判产生的候选协议进行表征和评估。
en_tdlr: This study proposes and evaluates a multi-step pipeline that integrates LLM-based agents into a human-supervised negotiation process for risk assessment, valuation, and negotiation in One Health contexts, characterizing candidate deals from simulated negotiations using Nash bargaining solution criteria and Pareto optimality metrics.
